Each restriction can only be used once except the attribute restriction. The available restrictions for Ranges are: - `realm`: The Realm name to search in. - `ip_address`: The IP address to search for within Ranges. - `ip_version`: The IP version to filter by (e.g., "IPV4", "IPV6"). - `parent_range`: The parent Range of the Range to search for. - `attribute_text`: The attribute text to search for within Ranges. - `attribute`: The attribute key and value to filter by. The available restrictions for Realms are: - `ip_version`: The IP version to search for. - `management_type`: The management type of the Realm (e.g., "CNR", "USER"). Only one of attribute_text or multiple attribute filters can be specified.
